pages.name: product-changelist
pages.extract: () => ({headers: [...document.querySelectorAll('#result_list thead th')].map(t=>t.innerText.trim()).filter(Boolean), rows: [...document.querySelectorAll('#result_list tbody tr')].map(r=>[...r.querySelectorAll('td,th')].map(c=>c.innerText.trim()).join(' | ')), filters: [...document.querySelectorAll('#changelist-filter h3, [data-filter-title], details summary, #changelist-filter summary')].map(h=>h.innerText.trim()).filter(Boolean), filterLinks: [...document.querySelectorAll('#changelist-filter a')].map(a=>a.getAttribute('href')).filter(h=>h&&h.includes('=')).slice(0,40), searchBox: !!document.querySelector('#searchbar, input[name=q]'), searchPlaceholder: document.querySelector('#searchbar, input[name=q]')?.getAttribute('placeholder'), dateHierarchy: [...document.querySelectorAll('.date-hierarchy a, #date-hierarchy a, [class*=date-hierarchy] a')].map(a=>a.innerText.trim()).slice(0,6), actions: [...document.querySelectorAll('select[name=action] option')].map(o=>o.value)})

pages.name: product-add
pages.extract: () => ({fields: [...document.querySelectorAll('form#product_form .form-row, form#product_form [class*=field-]')].map(r=>r.className.split(' ').filter(c=>c.startsWith('field-')).join(',')).filter(Boolean), widgets: [...document.querySelectorAll('form#product_form input:not([type=hidden]), form#product_form select, form#product_form textarea')].map(e=>e.name+':'+e.tagName.toLowerCase()+(e.type?'/'+e.type:'')+(e.className.includes('admin-autocomplete')?'/autocomplete':'')), kindOptions: [...document.querySelectorAll('select[name=kind] option')].map(o=>o.value+'='+o.text), readonly: [...document.querySelectorAll('.readonly')].map(e=>e.closest('[class*=field-]')?.className.split(' ').find(c=>c.startsWith('field-'))).filter(Boolean)})

pages.name: product-change
pages.extract: () => ({values: Object.fromEntries([...document.querySelectorAll('form#product_form input:not([type=hidden]):not([type=file]), form#product_form select, form#product_form textarea')].map(e=>[e.name, e.tagName==='SELECT' ? [...e.selectedOptions].map(o=>o.text).join(',') : (e.type==='checkbox'? e.checked : e.value)])), fileLinks: [...document.querySelectorAll('form#product_form a[href*=media]')].map(a=>a.getAttribute('href')), readonlyValues: [...document.querySelectorAll('.readonly')].map(e=>e.innerText.trim()).slice(0,8), imgPreview: !!document.querySelector('form#product_form img')})
